documentation.source:
# No TODO marker in text files

## Description

Reports TODO markers in text files.

## Rationale

A retained marker usually means unfinished work and should be reviewed before submission.

## Limitations

- Only checks eligible UTF-8 text files whose paths match the scope.
- Does not infer whether a TODO is intentional.
